lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: The Hundredwinter Gate. Someone is|knocking on it. Someone always was.
lines.text: The Hundredwinter Gate. Someone is knocking on it. Someone always was.

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: We don't know what follows them.|We could wait. Just until we see.
lines.text: We don't know what follows them. We could wait. Just until we see.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: I always waited until I saw.|Then there was nothing left to see.
lines.text: I always waited until I saw. Then there was nothing left to see.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Not this year. Open the gate, Aldra.|Or no. I will. My hands, this time.
lines.text: Not this year. Open the gate, Aldra. Or no. I will. My hands, this time.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Come in. Get warm. There is soup,|I'm told. I've never been told that before.
lines.text: Come in. Get warm. There is soup, I'm told. I've never been told that before.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: Out of the cracked north comes a long dark line:|carts, old men, children, and the hunt behind.
lines.text: Out of the cracked north comes a long dark line: carts, old men, children, and the hunt behind.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: Kettlewick stands. It remembers who opened|the gate once. Its shields come too.
lines.text: Kettlewick stands. It remembers who opened the gate once. Its shields come too.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Kettlewick. Twice now. Perhaps it's a habit.
lines.text: Kettlewick. Twice now. Perhaps it's a habit.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: Kettlewick is a ruin. The gate stayed shut|that winter. This column is what's left.
lines.text: Kettlewick is a ruin. The gate stayed shut that winter. This column is what's left.

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: Torvald, they're at the gate.|Whatever you're waiting for, it's here.
lines.text: Torvald, they're at the gate. Whatever you're waiting for, it's here.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: That's the last of them. Close it|behind them. Gates are for closing too.
lines.text: That's the last of them. Close it behind them. Gates are for closing too.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: They rest here. Four minutes. They walked|for three days. We hold for four minutes.
lines.text: They rest here. Four minutes. They walked for three days. We hold for four minutes.

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: You called. Before I asked. Winter's changing.
lines.text: You called. Before I asked. Winter's changing.

lines.speaker: obren
lines.subtitle: The ice cracks, Torvald.|Even yours. Especially yours.
lines.text: The ice cracks, Torvald. Even yours. Especially yours.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Then it cracks. Ice was never|the point. The line was.
lines.text: Then it cracks. Ice was never the point. The line was.

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: Both flanks! They want the|children. Hold the stair!
lines.text: Both flanks! They want the children. Hold the stair!

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Twenty. That's enough to be|a town. Keep them coming.
lines.text: Twenty. That's enough to be a town. Keep them coming.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Go south. Don't look back. There's|nothing back there worth the look.
lines.text: Go south. Don't look back. There's nothing back there worth the look.

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: The orb is warm. It hasn't|been warm in a hundred years.
lines.text: The orb is warm. It hasn't been warm in a hundred years.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Crown Hollow, then. Vessa waited.|I can hurry. Watch me.
lines.text: Crown Hollow, then. Vessa waited. I can hurry. Watch me.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Too slow... once more...
lines.text: Too slow... once more...

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: Too many lost. The road is closed to them now.
lines.text: Too many lost. The road is closed to them now.
